reviewTitle: Super comfortable, fantastic audio quality, exceptional light blocking, great for side sleeping
reviewDescription: I'm very pleased and impressed with this sleep mask and it checks a lot of boxes, if you're looking for a high quality sleep mask that's comfortable and has great audio support this is a solid choice. I've tried several other sleep masks and this one stands above most, definitely be best one for audio support and quality. The mask itself is well built and has a nice thick cushion that makes it super comfortable and provides great light blocking. The silky material is very comfortable on my face and eyes, and even though it's not a 3D style eye mask with a pocket for the eyes I still found it super comfortable and it does not irritate my sensitive eyes like some masks tend to do. The seams and spandex are high quality and the mask adjusts easily. The audio quality is surprisingly high for the bluetooth connection, the music is crisp and sounds fantastic. This is by far the best audio quality I've heard compared to some other sleep masks which tend to cut corners. The only lacking aspect is the bass, but for the use case and price it's definitely good enough. The ear buds are padded and very comfortable, so you can sleep on your side without irritation. I had zero issues connecting the bluetooth and the connection is very stable. The light blocking is exceptional on this mask, you get a pitch black sense and the only light bleed is under the nose but I haven't found a single mask that doesn't have that for me so this one has been on par with the best I've tried. As for any negatives I'd say the built-in white noise sounds are not high quality in terms of both the audio fidelity and also the quality of the white noise. For example, one of the water sounds like it's recorded from someone's shower, and the sound quality is muffled compared to the bluetooth sound so clearly they used low quality white noise. The outdoor insect sound is my favorite and it's passable. So the white noise will do in a pinch but I'd rely more on the bluetooth connection for music or white noise personally. The mask itself did have a lot of fabric fibers on it when I first opened the package that seemed to be from the manufacturing process that weren't thoroughly cleaned, so I did have to follow the cleaning instructions and take out the electronics and wash the mask before first use because I didn't want fibers getting in my eyes. But it wasn't a big issue and it's best to wash before use anyways.

reviewTitle: Great way to get quality sleep
reviewDescription: This Bluetooth sleep mask is pretty cool! Both myself and my son have used this. We both like it. It does help if you are used to using a sleep mask already. With this silk mask, it does move around a little bit, but I don’t find it problematic. The sound is good and while I can hear it, it’s a nice way not to disturb my partner. I’m happy with the changing time and battery life over time. Overall, this is a really nice product for the price. Bonus, it won’t irritate your skin. Plus, it isn’t hot for those of us who run hot or have hot flashes at night. I haven’t had any hot flashes triggered by this mask.
